patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark backgrounds and full-bleed light backgrounds, with content consistently constrained to a central maximum width.
Section headings are consistently large, bold, and set in uppercase, creating a strong, authoritative visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of black, dark grey, and white dominates, with a single vibrant orange used exclusively for branding, calls-to-action, and key interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the initial hero section, while the blue announcement banner disappears.
Content sections and individual elements reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
A prominent 'Latest News' section features a horizontal carousel of article cards, indicated by pagination dots below.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations (likely using locomotive-scroll) to create a dynamic content reveal experience, where sections and elements fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page. The main navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the screen after the initial hero content is scrolled out of view. The 'Latest News' section uses a horizontal content carousel (likely swiper) for browsing articles.

Content is structured using full-width sections that alternate between dark and light background colors, with all internal content aligned to a consistent, centrally-aligned maximum width. Feature sections often utilize an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing a large image or graphic with descriptive text.

Typography establishes a clear hierarchy with large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings for section titles, supported by a highly readable sans-serif for body text. Calls-to-action also use uppercase text for emphasis.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller uppercase labels for CTAs.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements, but predominantly sharp corners for overall section blocks and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-contrast black, white, and orange palette creates a bold and modern aesthetic that feels both professional and energetic. The dynamic scroll-triggered reveals, combined with the prominent display of partner logos and statistics, effectively conveys authority and engagement in the esports and gaming education space.
